backgroundZh: 东汉建和二年（148），汉中太守王升撰颂，表彰杨孟文开通石门之功。刻辞原在崖壁，后连石凿取，移藏汉中市博物馆。
background: A Eastern Han cliff inscription of 148 by the Hanzhong governor Wang Sheng, praising Yang Mengwen for opening the Shimen passage. Cut from the cliff and moved into the Hanzhong Museum.
